Command.Comment: RAGIN phase3 discover server_v2 routes and middleware

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
SRC="/opt/ragin/ragin/server_v2.py"
if [ -f "$SRC" ]; then
  echo SRC=$SRC
  echo HASH=$(sha256sum "$SRC" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  echo CREATE_APP_BEGIN
  python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, pathlib, sys
p = pathlib.Path("/opt/ragin/ragin/server_v2.py")
tree = ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
hits = []
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(node, ast.AsyncFunctionDef) or isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
        name = getattr(node, "name", None)
        if not name:
            continue
        src = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        line = src.splitlines()[node.lineno-1] if node.lineno else ""
        hits.append((node.lineno, name, line.strip()[:120]))
for ln,name,line in hits:
    print(f"{ln}\t{name}\t{line}")
PY
  echo CREATE_APP_END
  echo ROUTE_REGISTRATION_GREP
  grep -nE "add_route|app\.mount|route\(|@app|include_router|add_head|add_get|add_post|add_put|add_delete|add_options|\"ragin|\"/v1|\"/api|/command|/chat|/session|/health|/ready|add_route.*command|add_route.*chat|add_route.*session|add_route.*health|add_route.*ready" /opt/ragin/ragin/server_v2.py 2>/dev/null | head -n 200 || true
  echo MIDDLEWARE_GREP
  grep -nE "def app\(|middleware|before_request|after_request|requires|auth|verif|session|cors|rate|limit|parse|schema|request_id|RAGIN_MTLS|CLIENT_CERT|AllowedIdentities|require_auth|RAGIN_REQUIRE_AUTH" /opt/ragin/ragin/server_v2.py 2>/dev/null | head -n 200 || true
  echo SESSION_AND_REQUEST_ID_GREP
  grep -nE "request_id|session_id|correlation|X-Correlation|response_meta|websocket|request\.json|await request|post\(|put\(|get\(|delete\(" /opt/ragin/ragin/server_v2.py 2>/dev/null | head -n 200 || true
  echo VERIFIER_GREP
  grep -nE "verif|FictionConsistencyVerifier|verifier|serve_path|GENERATED|fdist|fallback|candidate_sha256|approval|Verifier" /opt/ragin/ragin/server_v2.py 2>/dev/null | head -n 200 || true
  echo KEYCONFIG_GREP
  grep -nE "RAGIN_MTLS|ALLOWED_IDENTITIES|CLIENT_CERT|CERT_FILE|KEY_FILE|CA_FILE|commonname|verify|require|SPDY|OpenSSL|ssl.SSLContext|ssl.create_default_context|PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER|CERT_REQUIRED|check_hostname" /opt/ragin/ragin/server_v2.py 2>/dev/null | head -n 200 || true
else
  echo SRC_MISSING=$SRC
fi
echo DONE
